body:
Well, as some of you may know I am an ocn regular. I recently found in interest in these fine server and the style of gameplay and its slight differences from ocn has appealed to me. I'd love to get into some of the competitive side to Avicus with teams. I have plenty of experience with ocn teams so I have all of the necessities like skype, mumble, ts, etc...  I am a US player and am very active, you will see me on nearly every night. 

Pros:
Very good at the bow, will make consistent shots from nearly any range. I mainly excel at long rage shots as I have a 2006 archer elo on badlion. 

Great at sword, may not be the greatest at pot pvp but when you put me in a 1v1 I will always find a way to prevail. 

intelligent player in matches, I always manage to quickly digest any situation whether it be a coordinated push to holding off on skybridge in any way possibly. I can analyze the possibilities if I did x or y with speed. 

Rushing, probably my greatest attribute. I am very good at tunnel juking, understanding the maps gameplay, chokepoints, timing of pushes, etc... I am a pain to hold off as I will tend to deceive defenders into my whereabouts and then proceed to get the knock. 

I know how to Shroom bridge (Shift, unshift) for both staircase and straightbridge. I am learning how to bleeple bridge and am starting to get it down. 

I can cannon, I know many cannons that mostly come from ocn. I can build these with fair speed and decent accuracy as well. However this is not my strong point.

I am chill guy to hang out with, mature and am able to take criticism. 

Willing to put in plenty of effort into the team such as scrims, practicing, and improving. 

Cons:
I tend to play aggressively and on occasions I take too much of a risk.

When I don't succeed I can get fairly frustrated but I have learned to control this for the most part.

I am new to Avicus so I am not familiar with much but I should be able to overcome this hump with time and practice. 

I as some now participate on a OCN team so on certain circumstances that will come first in front of the avicus team. 

I am not fond of defending.

Contact information:
Skype: Lukekart59skype say who you are when adding me.
